instructions: Install the composable controls used by Sales Configurator delivery blocs.
Apply the private Supabase schema and deploy the cms-sales-configurator Edge Function.
Install the generated bearer token in the CMS secret store and Supabase function secrets.
Publish modules, variants, contextual features, prerequisites, and sales-partner access.
checks: The sales_configurator schema stays private to anon and authenticated Supabase roles.
Partner ownership always comes from the CMS-computed x-cms-user-id header.
Prices, prerequisites, snapshots, and totals are calculated by transactional server commands.
Public proposal reads require a valid opaque share token and expose only the client projection.
resources: Private sales_configurator schema and Edge Function
review: Do not trust browser-provided ownership, prices, totals, prerequisites, or snapshots.
Keep private notes and event metadata out of public share responses.
Archive catalogue rows referenced by proposal snapshots instead of deleting them.
sync: Install Sales Configurator source and dashboards
syncNote: Sales Configurator stores domain state in Supabase while CmsCore owns identities, endpoint access, and editable presentation.
